correctness.rationale: The four stated weak-Heyting identities force antecedent antitonicity, consequent monotonicity, top for a<=b, and the adjacent-edge minimum formula. Conversely arbitrary edge values satisfy the four axioms. Box values are suffix minima of the edges, yielding all weakly increasing length-n sequences and binom(2n,n) reducts. Each adjacent repeated box value b_i contributes |[b_i,top]| independent edge choices; strictly increasing transitions force edges. The 2^n singleton fibers and maximal (n+1)^(n-1) fiber (unique for n>=2) follow. Independently enumerated and checked every edge vector against all axiom instances for n=1,2,3 and fiber counts.
